correctness.rationale: For a generic normal, cap-edge cuts contribute four when t<horizontal support, while exactly two vertical edges cross for each antipodal vertex pair with projection rho<t; after t exceeds largest rho the section has 2m sides. Uniform absolute vertical spherical coordinate gives F_h(r)=r/sqrt(h^2+r^2). Ordered projection intervals yield full law; P4 strictly decreases from 1 to0 by dominated convergence. For a regular hexagon cosine antiderivatives give three probabilities; derivative of P8 changes sign only at h=sqrt5/2. Independent numerical boundary calculations passed.
